findings.obs_text: In Act 8:20 Simon supposed God's gift could be bought, and Peter curses his silver: the thought tries to take what is given. In Luk 8:18 what one thinks he has will be taken away. In 2Ki 7:12 the king thinks the Syrians will take the people alive, in Mat 17:25 Jesus asks Simon what he thinks about from whom kings take tribute, and in 2Cor 10:5 every thought is taken captive to Christ.
findings.grounds: you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money

findings.obs_text: In Neh 6:9 the enemies think the workers' hands will drop from the work, and Nehemiah asks God to strengthen his hands: the prayer answers the enemies' thought.
findings.grounds: But now, O God, strengthen my hands

findings.obs_text: In Mat 6:7 the Gentiles pray thinking many words will be heard: a false thought about prayer. In Mat 26:53 Jesus asks whether they think he cannot appeal to his Father: the thought misjudges his power to ask. In 2Sa 14:15 the woman thought the king might grant her request.
findings.grounds: Do you think that I cannot appeal to my Father

findings.obs_text: In Pro 12:5 the thoughts of the righteous are set against the counsels of the wicked: thought and counsel stand as the two sides. In Mat 22:16 and Mar 12:14 the questioners say Jesus teaches the way of God truly and does not care about anyone's standing.
findings.grounds: the counsels of the wicked are deceitful

findings.obs_text: In Rom 1:21 those who knew God did not give thanks, and they became futile in their thinking: withholding thanks goes with the thinking becoming futile.
findings.grounds: they did not honor him as God or give thanks to him
